newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen volatile.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen volatile.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.10 down at 41.45 to the dollar on Wednesday amid low supply of the U.S. currency as commercial centres in Karachi remained shut for the second day after violence, dealers said.
"Most markets are closed and the dollar supply is low against its demand," dealer Owais Kalia said. "The rupee will seesaw in the coming days."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.50 percent compared to its previous close at 2.70. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
